Author: STRNDV
Name: Design Bulk Editor
Description: Group Glamourer designs by character, edit names/folders/properties across many designs at once, and preview a staged edit on your logged-in character before saving. Unofficial, community-built, not affiliated with Glamourer/Ottermandias.
Punchline: Bulk-edit your Glamourer design library and preview changes live, without leaving the game.
